body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{cert}}\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\) and fixed \(\iota\), enumerate the finite admissible input class; propagate directed-rounding Taylor models and recursive Poisson tails through wrong-graph exclusion, local chart injectivity, remote within-graph separation, Jacobian nonsingularity, covariance inversion, and designated-contrast precision; retain the nondominated proof objects.
